Journal

Notes, not claims.

The Journal is where plants, practices and ordinary attention are written about properly: what is known, what is tradition, and what is still unproven.

What will be here

Plant notes covering botany, origin, cultivation and the history of use. Practice notes on breath, rest and attention. Essays on mind and body wellness that are not tied to a product.

How products are linked

Where a note touches something OPAR stocks, the link back to the shop is an invitation, not a promise. The Journal does not claim that a product treats, prevents or cures anything, and it does not publish a claim a supplier has not evidenced.

The rule applied here

Facts are stated as facts. Tradition is labelled as tradition, with a source. Outcomes are left out. This is not modesty; it is what the law on food supplements and cosmetics requires, and it is also the only way the writing stays worth reading.

The first essays are in preparation. Nothing is published here just to fill the page.
